notablePrerequisites: you control at least four lands.
description:
Cast Tainted Strike, giving Purphoros +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Avenger of Zendikar.
Avenger of Zendikar enters, triggering itself and Purphoros.
Resolve the Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating a Plant token for each land you control.
The tokens enter, triggering Purphoros four times.
Resolve All Purphoros triggers giving each opponent ten poison counters.
